novelty_scope: Compared with inspected GEMSDOE21 and pinned H19 physical-transform code; not worldwide or private-group novelty

candidates.name: Signed cross-normal step topology
candidates.mechanism: Fault displacement juxtaposes density/magnetic-property blocks; buried minor strands may leave concentrated step-shaped field profiles without a prominent scarp.
candidates.layers: Isostatic gravity band 13, RTP band 2, existing terrain summaries in the paired clean control
candidates.signature: Concentrated monotone cross-gradient profiles, step-compatible opposing normal-curvature lobes, and within-field persistence at Gaussian sigma 1 and 3 pixels; six extra channels
candidates.missing_fault_rationale: Can target covered or subtle strands without requiring both gravity and magnetics to respond. This is a hypothesis, not a catalogue-gap truth label.
candidates.novelty: Within-field signed profile topology, not H19 magnitude-only worms or H21-1 cross-field axial agreement
candidates.confounder: Intrusive/depositional contacts, basin margins without a surface trace, remanence and gridding seams
candidates.cost: Medium / CPU; no new predictor data
candidates.status: REJECTED FOR PROMOTION: all four forecasts missed; 2/4 dense wins; 8/8 converged; no clean best/fresh confirmation; zero slots

candidates.name: Cross-scarp radiometric compositional continuity
candidates.mechanism: Displaced surface materials may produce a repeated signed compositional jump across a terrain breakline.
candidates.layers: Pinned GeoDAWN radiometric channels/ratio derivatives and terrain normals
candidates.signature: Positive-support log-ratio difference across ±2 pixels with along-strike sign consistency at ±5 pixels; channel-unit reconstruction must precede implementation
candidates.missing_fault_rationale: Low scarps inside broadly mapped units might separate materials overlooked in regional fault catalogues.
candidates.novelty: Directional continuity across a scarp, not absolute/local K/Th alteration amplitude
candidates.confounder: Weathering, soil/alluvial provenance, moisture and survey boundaries; radiometric ranks are not physical concentration ratios
candidates.status: DEFERRED / UNTESTED; uint8 quantization does not preserve ratio units

candidates.name: Conductive-side structural asymmetry
candidates.mechanism: Altered/fractured sediment-side material may be more conductive on the less-dense/less-magnetic side of a structure.
candidates.layers: Conductivity band 17, gravity band 13 and RTP band 2
candidates.signature: Signed cross-normal conductivity residual sidedness relative to physical-property contrasts, not simple amplitude coincidence
candidates.missing_fault_rationale: Covered strands may have no large scarp or surface thermal manifestation; directional context could distinguish competing material boundaries.
candidates.novelty: Explicit edge sidedness rather than existing clay-conduit/demagnetization amplitude products
candidates.confounder: Cold saline lake sediments, impermeable clay, nonfault contacts and coarse MT resolution; no direct inference of permeability or vents
candidates.status: DEFERRED / UNTESTED; resolution/physical interpretation still needs audit

candidates.name: Time-persistent, depth-coherent earthquake planes
candidates.mechanism: Recurrent slip may produce a depth-coherent hypocentral plane with persistent strike across disjoint time periods.
candidates.layers: USGS ComCat event origins, depths, horizontal/depth errors and event type, plus physical fields
candidates.signature: Uncertainty-aware local covariance and time-split orientation consistency, not pregridded earthquake density
candidates.missing_fault_rationale: Active concealed structures can generate hypocentres without an obvious mapped surface trace; aseismic faults remain undetectable by this mechanism.
candidates.novelty: Event-depth/time/uncertainty geometry instead of density/strain rasters
candidates.confounder: Aftershock swarms, operations, quarry blasts, hypocentre errors and the nonunique projection to a 100m surface trace
candidates.cost: High; new official event catalogue needed
candidates.status: CONDITIONAL / UNTESTED; only a 100-event schema probe obtained, 54 lack horizontal uncertainty
